en.joke: I downloaded a productivity app, then spent an hour customizing it instead of being productive.
en.explanation: It highlights the irony of intending to be productive with technology but getting sidetracked by the tech itself.

people.name: Stefanos Tsitsipas
people.extract: Stefanos Tsitsipas is a Greek professional tennis player. He has been ranked as high as world No. 3 in men's singles by the Association of Tennis Professionals (ATP), first achieved in August 2021 – making him the highest-ranked Greek men's tennis player. Tsitsipas has won thirteen ATP Tour singles titles, including the 2019 ATP Finals and three Masters 1000 events. He has contested two major finals, at the 2021 French Open and 2023 Australian Open, making him the first Greek tennis player to reach a Grand Slam final. He has a career-high doubles ranking of No. 64, achieved on 29 August 2022.
highlights: Achieved world No. 3 ranking in men's singles.
Won 2019 ATP Finals and three Masters 1000 events.
Reached finals at 2021 French Open and 2023 Australian Open.

people.name: Louise de Marillac
people.extract: Louise de Marillac, also known as Louise Le Gras, was the co-founder, with Vincent de Paul, of the Daughters of Charity. She is venerated as a saint by the Catholic Church and the Episcopal Church in the United States of America.
highlights: Co-founder of the Daughters of Charity.
Venerated as a saint by the Catholic Church.
Also known as Louise Le Gras.
